name: Alex Moreno
body: I am applying for the Graduate Environmental Scientist role. I finished my MSc in Environmental Chemistry this year, and during my internship at a water utility I analysed more than 300 drinking-water samples and wrote the weekly quality reports.

The part I enjoyed most was making the data useful. I wrote a small Python script that checks every result against legal limits and flags anything unusual, which cut our weekly report time from three hours to twenty minutes.
I would be glad to bring the same care for data and clear reporting to your team. My CV is attached.
